result.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://long-banana.com/
result.summary: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LongBanana，一个面向长上下文多参考图像合成的专家设计并核验基准，包含 90 个任务、每任务约 32 张参考图与近 4,670 条原子评价项，用实体-关系图把节点、边与全局约束转成清单式评分；并给出 LongBanana-Gen 智能体框架，比较直接生成与含 RPR 流程的 harness 在证据落地与修复上的差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 「分散视觉证据检索、干扰项排除、实体关系绑定」的任务表述与图约束式评测，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、关系保持与评价设计提供参照，但其最终产物是合成图像而非可检查的 latent 推理状态，与主线仅为间接关联，可供核查。
